title: [Task Sprint] QA Testing Report — Villume Admin

issues.main_description_html:
Epic 0 — Shared building blocks

In-memory wizard state service + step guards for the 3-step gallery-creation flow.

Scope

  • WizardStateService holds chosen space, gallery name, and uploaded files across steps.
  • Route guards prevent deep-linking step 2/3 without completing step 1 (redirect to step 1).
  • Reset rules when the flow completes or is abandoned.

Acceptance criteria

  • State persists across back/next within the flow; refresh restarts the wizard (acceptable); guards enforce order.

Testing scenario (QA)

  1. Complete step 1, go to step 2, press Back → step 1 still shows the chosen space.
  2. Try to open step 3 URL directly without step 1 → redirected to step 1.
  3. Refresh mid-wizard → flow restarts cleanly (no broken/partial state).
  4. Finish the flow → state resets (starting again is fresh).

QA Tester Summary - Issue #1597: WizardStateService + step guards

Suite: qa_testing/scripts/record-issue-1597-wizard-state-real.cjs + source review (Chromium - display-2 fullscreen address-bar recording)
Env: Dev https://dev.villume.com with Access-Code header, real support session, real room/gallery API data
Status: Failed

# Box Scenario Given -> Expected Matrix Result
1 Black Step 1 real data Open /{username}/create -> real room templates render and Continue is disabled until a space is selected Dev UI + API Passed

3 Black Refresh mid-wizard Refresh from Step 2 -> wizard restarts cleanly at Step 1 Dev UI Passed
4 Black Deep-link guard check Attempt direct Step 3 query without Step 1 -> remains/restarts at Step 1 Dev UI Passed for current route surface
5 Black Finish/reset Complete Step 1 -> Step 2 -> Step 3 -> create gallery; starting again should be fresh Step 1 Dev UI + API Passed

Refresh restart Refresh mid-wizard restarts cleanly After reload, Step 1 rendered with no selected space and Continue disabled Passed
Step 3 guard/deep link Step 3 should not be reachable without prior state Current public route has no path-based Step 3 URL; direct query attempt stayed at Step 1 Passed for current route shape

Request Status Review

POST /v1/exhibitions/process/create 200 Create-process validation passed

Code Review

File Review
src/app/components/create-exhibition/create-exhibition.component.ts getSelectedExhibition() stores selection only in local exhibitionData; it does not persist the chosen space into CreateExhibitionService.exhibitionData for wizard state reuse.
src/app/components/create-exhibition/create-exhibition.component.ts backAction() case 2 explicitly clears this.exhibitionName = '' and this.exhibitionData = {} before decrementing to Step 1, which explains the failed Back-state acceptance.
src/app/components/create-exhibition/services/create-exhibition.service.ts Service exposes stepWizard and exhibitionData, but there is no complete WizardStateService-style API for chosen space, gallery name, uploaded files, reset rules, or step guard checks.
src/app/pages/profile/create/create.component.ts The route initializes this._createService.stepWizard = 1, which supports clean refresh/re-entry but does not provide guarded path steps for Step 2/3.

Evidence

  • Display-2 fullscreen/maximized address-bar video captured the real dev flow from Step 1 selection through Step 2 Back failure, refresh restart, Step 3, GalleryCreated success, and fresh restart.
  • Screenshots captured Step 1 real data, Step 2 name entry, Back-to-Step-1 state loss, refresh restart, finish success, and reset-after-close.
  • Runtime state confirms the failure: after selecting Oslo and pressing Back from Step 2, checkedNames became [], selectedCardCount became 0, and Continue became disabled.
  • Video frame check confirms the recording includes the browser address bar.

Bug Notes

  • This is a product/state-management bug, not a QA setup issue.
  • The key failing acceptance is: Complete step 1, go to step 2, press Back -> step 1 still shows the chosen space.
  • Real data was used; room cards and create-gallery backend calls came from dev APIs.

issues.display_title: Issue #1628: [slicing] Migrate My Galleries to dashboard shell with redesigned gallery cards
issues.main_description_html:
Epic: My Galleries (src/app/pages/profile/main/)

Replace main.component.html markup with the redesigned dashboard layout. Keep the existing TS data layer (getExhibitions, deleteExhibition, openShareLink, countdown, startCreating).

Scope:

  • Wrap in DashboardShellComponent.
  • .gallery-board: .new-gallery tile (→ Start Creating) + .gcard per exhibition.
  • Live/Draft status badge (replaces published/not-published icon images).
  • Hover actions View / Edit / Share / Delete (reuse existing handlers); visitor view = View + Share only.
  • Preserve countdown overlay.
  • Empty state ("No galleries found").
  • Replace inline JS image-height math with CSS aspect-ratio.

Acceptance: view/edit/share/delete unchanged in function; badges correct; countdown intact; responsive.

Depends on: Build DashboardShellComponent.
